review.decision: The final frozen source remains within the approved one-arm R15 sparse+EMA / R7 NLL comparison. The runtime setup and reference-archive loading path are fail-closed and bound to the final manifest. No implementation blocker remains in this scoped review.
checks: I independently rehashed all 38 entries in the final preparation manifest; all matched. Its exact runtime map contains 31 modules, and the source code checks the exact observed owned-package module inventory and resolved paths before execution. The final source-only cold-smoke receipt reports 31 of 31 modules and no calls to any of the seven NumPy, Torch, or PyArrow payload-read sentinels.

The final CLI verifies the pinned manifest and sample/membership identities, loads and verifies the declared runtime closure, then calls the pinned R15 CPU-runtime configurator before importing the executor. The executor rechecks FP32, one intra-op and inter-op thread, CUDA uninitialized, autocast disabled, and both TF32 flags disabled before sample loading. The final receipt records those runtime values; setup does not access model or sample payloads.

The R15 compact result remains bound by exact bytes and hash. The archive path is confined to the expected R15 research_tmp directory; the archive is size- and SHA-checked before np.load, and its complete key set is compared with the captured result metadata. Only the six whitelisted raw-input, sparse dictionary, and sparse downstream-normalizer arrays are indexed and retained. A focused synthetic archive check used the pinned compact metadata to emulate a 22-key archive and confirmed exactly those six accesses; its archive hash and dictionary fingerprint were deliberately stubbed, so it does not claim validation of the actual archive payload.

The final source-only receipt has nine passing focused tests, Ruff check/format passes, a 31-module cold import smoke with all seven read sentinels untouched, and a separate runtime-flag observation. The compact R15 fixture and runtime receipts have matching recorded byte hashes. No actual R15 archive or R3 sample payload was opened by this reviewer.

The previously reviewed fixed training design and endpoint logic are unchanged. This remains one fresh 12-epoch, 756-update, 381,696-row-exposure NLL predictor compared with stored sparse-WMSE R15 results; the fit-only causal features and one final exposed-panel score do not identify sparse-by-NLL synergy.
